cells.gaps: No source shows the national numbers checked by biometrics for duplicates, and the digital ID's Level 3 assurance is set for a layer still in trials with banks, not issued to the population.
cells.note: Restaged 2026-11-09 on Bill's ruling (message 108): the Level 3 assurance set in April 2026 is for the Digital Identity Management System for Citizens, still in bank trials, so it is no yes to stage 5 and answers no earlier question. The national number is in service and issued to all nationals, but no source shows biometric deduplication.
